Subject: Your land dispute matter - R.C.S. No. 2680/2020

Dear Ms. Bhandari,

Thank you for meeting us on 03/06/2021 about your dispute with Farhan Chandran. As we understand it, the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot.

Our advice is to apply for a court commissioner to measure the boundary. Please collect the sale deed, the survey map and the land records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
